# Healthy Solutions for Children and Families (HSCF)

> Bilingual (Spanish and English) mental health center in Doral, Florida. Psychotherapy for children, teens, adults, couples and families; ABA therapy; psychological and developmental testing for ages 2 to 21; parent workshops; neurofeedback, reflective yoga, coaching and hypnotherapy. The site's main language is Spanish; English pages are under /en/.

Key facts:
- Address: 8245 NW 36th St, Suite 7, Doral, FL 33166
- Phone: (305) 594-5658 or (786) 423-9495 · Email: info@hscfdoral.com
- Languages: Spanish and English (one therapist also works in Portuguese)
- Insurance: in network with Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna and UnitedHealthcare; also works with Oscar and Bind; does not accept TRICARE
- Private packages: 8, 12 or 16 weekly sessions
- Areas served: Doral, Miami-Dade County, Hialeah, Miami Lakes, Coral Gables, Kendall, Miami, Miami Springs, Sweetwater
- Not an emergency service. In a crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.

## Services

- [ABA therapy](https://hscfdoral.com/en/aba-therapy/): Applied Behavior Analysis to build communication, social skills and independence.
- [Individual, family and couples therapy](https://hscfdoral.com/en/individual-family-couples-therapy/): Individual, group, family and couples therapy for children, teens and adults.
- [Workshops and talks for parents](https://hscfdoral.com/en/parent-workshops-and-talks/): Workshops for parents, teens and educators who want to grow and connect better.
- [Neurofeedback](https://hscfdoral.com/en/neurofeedback/): Brain training that supports attention, focus and emotional regulation.
- [Reflective yoga](https://hscfdoral.com/en/reflective-yoga/): A space to connect the physical body with the quality of being.
- [Coaching](https://hscfdoral.com/en/coaching/): Guidance to discover your own tools and reach your goals.
- [Hypnotherapy](https://hscfdoral.com/en/hypnotherapy/): Deep relaxation to work on stress, habits and limiting beliefs.
- [Courses and workshops](https://hscfdoral.com/en/courses-and-workshops/): Courses on adolescence, self-esteem, language, neuroplasticity and parenting.
- [Insurance, packages and testing](https://hscfdoral.com/en/insurance/): We accept Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna and UnitedHealthcare, and offer private packages of 8, 12 or 16 sessions and testing for ages 2 to 21.

## Staff

- [Jorge Garcia](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/jorge-garcia/): Therapist. An interactive therapist who blends cognitive-behavioral, client-centered and psychodynamic approaches.
- [Armando Matiz Reyes](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/armando-matiz-reyes/): Psychosocial development facilitator and clinical hypnosis practitioner. An IAF-certified facilitator trained in NLP and clinical hypnosis, and a public health researcher.
- [María Cecilia Mauricio](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/maria-cecilia-mauricio/): Coach, consultant and therapist in communication, language, body awareness and emotions. More than 17 years helping children, families, adults and couples express themselves and connect better.
- [José Mesa, BCaBA](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/jose-mesa/): Behavior analyst (BCaBA). More than 10 years with children and young people with special educational needs, focused on autism.
- [Juan Felipe Díaz, M.Ed.](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/juan-felipe-diaz/): Counselor and behavior therapist. A counselor and behavior therapist with more than 10 years of helping clients reach their goals.
- [Paula Callegari](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/paula-callegari/): Trilingual therapist and certified therapeutic riding instructor. A trilingual therapist for children, teens, adults and families, including equine-assisted therapy.
- [Silvia Lugo](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/silvia-lugo/): Clinical psychology doctoral student with a master’s in sport psychology. A doctoral student in clinical psychology at Albizu University, with a master’s in sport psychology.
- [Alibel Osorio](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/alibel-osorio/): Therapist and hypnotherapist. More than 20 years of experience and a master’s in clinical psychology; practical therapy for children, couples and families.
- [Beatriz Pedreira, MSW, RCSWI](https://hscfdoral.com/en/staff/beatriz-pedreira/): Registered Clinical Social Work Intern (RCSWI). Bilingual, with a Master of Social Work from Florida State University; works with clients of all ages.

## Blog

- [Signs of Anxiety in Children and How Parents Can Help](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2026/10/signs-of-anxiety-in-children/): How to tell everyday worry from an anxiety disorder in children, which treatments research supports, and practical ways parents can help at home.
- [Beyond the Body: Why Prioritizing Mental Health Matters](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2023/05/beyond-the-body-why-prioritizing-mental-health-matters/): Why mental health deserves the same care as physical health, how stigma keeps people from seeking help, and common myths about therapy.
- [How to Manage Anxiety Attacks](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2022/07/how-to-manage-anxiety-attacks/): The common signs of an anxiety attack and practical steps to calm one, from slowing your breathing to grounding your senses, plus when to get help.
- [Why a Psychology Professional Matters](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2022/04/why-a-psychology-professional-matters/): Why seeing a psychologist is as ordinary as seeing any other health professional, and what a psychologist does in therapy to help people change.
- [Teen Groups!](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2022/02/teen-groups/): A small therapy group for 3 to 5 teens focused on self-esteem, anxiety, depression and relationships, in a safe space where teens can connect.
- [Staying Healthy Is Up to You!](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2022/01/staying-healthy-is-up-to-you/): Everyday habits that support both body and mind, from a positive outlook and gratitude to social connection, exercise, sleep and good nutrition.
- [Mind-Body Health](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/11/mind-body-health/): An introduction to psychoneuroimmunoendocrinology, the field that studies the mind and body as one unit, and to how stress can affect the body's defenses.
- [Attention and Focus](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/10/attention-and-focus/): Attention is the step before memory. Learn what can reduce it and get practical tips, from fewer distractions to breaks and sleep hygiene, to focus better.
- [What Is Memory?](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/09/what-is-memory/): Memory lets us keep and recall facts, ideas and experiences. Here are simple everyday habits, like good sleep, less stress and exercise, that support it.
- [What Is Cogmed?](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/08/what-is-cogmed/): Cogmed is an online working memory training program that aims to improve attention, school and work performance. See how it works and how long it lasts.
- [How to Help Your Child Cope With Their Parents' Separation](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/07/how-to-help-your-child-cope-with-parents-separation/): Children can feel many mixed emotions when their parents separate. These simple tips can help you support your child through separation or divorce.
- [Well-Being in the Family](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/06/well-being-in-the-family/): Why family matters and four simple areas to work on at home: nutrition, movement, time outdoors with less screen time, and quality time together.
- [Play Therapy Training with Lisa Saldana (2021)](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/06/play-therapy-training-with-lisa-saldana-2021/): In June and July 2021, therapist Lisa Saldana gave a play therapy training series at HSCF for our team of therapists and the community.
- [Effective or Assertive Communication](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/06/effective-or-assertive-communication/): What assertive communication means for a couple and five practical tips, from choosing the right moment to talk to sharing your emotions honestly.
- [How Can I Improve My Mental Health?](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/05/how-can-i-improve-my-mental-health/): Why mental health matters and everyday ways to care for it, from gratitude, sleep and exercise to connection, meditation and relaxation techniques.
- [Balance and Harmony: Coping with COVID-19 After the Vaccine](https://hscfdoral.com/en/2021/04/balance-and-harmony-coping-with-covid-19-after-the-vaccine/): A look at how COVID-19 affected emotional health, what early studies reported about fear, anxiety and depression, and the kinds of support that build resilience.

## En español (idioma principal)

- [Inicio](https://hscfdoral.com/): Psicoterapia, terapia ABA, evaluaciones y talleres para padres en un centro bilingüe de Doral. Te acompañamos en cada etapa de la vida.
- [Terapia ABA](https://hscfdoral.com/aba/): Análisis Conductual Aplicado para desarrollar la comunicación, las habilidades sociales y la independencia.
- [Psicoterapia individual, familiar y de parejas](https://hscfdoral.com/psicoterapia-individual-familiar-y-de-parejas/): Terapia individual, de grupo, familiar y de pareja para niños, adolescentes y adultos.
- [Talleres y charlas para padres](https://hscfdoral.com/talleres-y-charlas-a-padres/): Talleres para padres, adolescentes y educadores que buscan crecer y relacionarse mejor.
- [Neurofeedback](https://hscfdoral.com/neurofeedback/): Entrenamiento cerebral que apoya la atención, la concentración y la regulación emocional.
- [Yoga reflexivo](https://hscfdoral.com/yoga/): Un espacio para conectar el cuerpo físico con la calidad del ser.
- [Coaching](https://hscfdoral.com/coaching-hipnoterapia/): Un acompañamiento para descubrir tus propias herramientas y alcanzar tus metas.
- [Hipnoterapia](https://hscfdoral.com/hipnoterapia/): Relajación profunda para trabajar el estrés, los hábitos y las creencias limitantes.
- [Cursos y talleres](https://hscfdoral.com/cursos-y-talleres/): Cursos sobre adolescencia, autoestima, lenguaje, neuroplasticidad y crianza.
- [Seguros y paquetes](https://hscfdoral.com/seguros/): Aceptamos Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna y UnitedHealthcare, y ofrecemos paquetes privados de 8, 12 o 16 sesiones y evaluaciones de 2 a 21 años.
- [Síntomas de ansiedad en niños y cómo puedes ayudar a tu hijo](https://hscfdoral.com/2026/10/sintomas-de-ansiedad-en-ninos/): Cómo distinguir la preocupación normal de un trastorno de ansiedad en niños, qué tratamientos tienen respaldo científico y cómo puedes ayudar a tu hijo en casa.
- [Más allá del cuerpo: la importancia de priorizar la salud mental](https://hscfdoral.com/2023/05/mas-alla-del-cuerpo-la-importancia-de-priorizar-la-salud-mental/): Por qué la salud mental merece el mismo cuidado que la salud física, cómo el estigma impide buscar ayuda y cuáles son los mitos más comunes sobre la terapia.
- [¿Cómo manejar los ataques de ansiedad?](https://hscfdoral.com/2022/07/como-manejar-los-ataques-de-ansiedad/): Los síntomas más comunes de un ataque de ansiedad y pasos prácticos para calmarlo, desde regular la respiración hasta conectar con tus sentidos, y cuándo pedir ayuda.
- [La importancia del profesional en psicología](https://hscfdoral.com/2022/04/la-importancia-del-profesional-en-psicologia/): Por qué ir al psicólogo es tan normal como visitar a cualquier profesional de la salud y qué hace un psicólogo en terapia para ayudar a las personas a cambiar.
- [¡Grupos para adolescentes!](https://hscfdoral.com/2022/02/teen-groups/): Un grupo pequeño de terapia para 3 a 5 adolescentes enfocado en la autoestima, la ansiedad, la depresión y las relaciones, en un espacio seguro para conectar.
- [¡Estar sano depende de ti!](https://hscfdoral.com/2022/01/estar-sano-depende-de-ti/): Hábitos cotidianos que cuidan el cuerpo y la mente, desde una actitud positiva y la gratitud hasta la conexión social, el ejercicio, el sueño y una buena alimentación.
- [Salud mente-cuerpo](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/11/salud-mente-cuerpo/): Una introducción a la psiconeuroinmunoendocrinología, que estudia la mente y el cuerpo como una sola unidad, y a cómo el estrés puede afectar las defensas del organismo.
- [La atención y la concentración](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/10/la-atencion-y-la-concentracion/): La atención es el paso previo a la memoria. Conoce qué puede reducirla y algunos tips prácticos, desde evitar distracciones hasta hacer pausas y cuidar el sueño.
- [¿Qué es la memoria?](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/09/que-es-la-memoria/): La memoria nos permite retener y recordar hechos, ideas y experiencias. Te compartimos hábitos sencillos, como dormir bien, reducir el estrés y hacer ejercicio.
- [¿Qué es Cogmed?](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/08/que-es-cogmed/): Cogmed es un programa virtual de entrenamiento de la memoria de trabajo que busca mejorar la atención y el rendimiento académico y profesional.
- [Cómo ayudar al niño a afrontar la situación de separación de sus padres](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/07/como-ayudar-al-nino-a-afrontar-la-situacion-de-separacion-de-sus-padres/): Los niños pueden sentir muchas emociones encontradas cuando sus padres se separan. Estos tips sencillos te ayudan a acompañar a tu hijo en este proceso.
- [El bienestar en la familia](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/06/el-bienestar-en-la-familia/): Por qué la familia importa y cuatro áreas sencillas para trabajar en casa: alimentación, movimiento, aire libre con menos pantallas y tiempo de calidad juntos.
- [Capacitación en terapia de juego con Lisa Saldana (2021)](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/06/lisa-saldana-presents-play-therapy-training/): En junio y julio de 2021, la terapeuta Lisa Saldana ofreció en HSCF una serie de capacitaciones en terapia de juego para nuestro equipo de terapeutas y la comunidad.
- [La comunicación efectiva o asertiva](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/06/la-comunicacion-efectiva-o-asertiva/): Qué significa la comunicación asertiva en la pareja y cinco consejos prácticos, desde elegir el momento oportuno para hablar hasta compartir tus emociones con sinceridad.
- [¿Cómo puedo mejorar mi salud mental?](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/05/como-puedo-mejorar-mi-salud-mental/): Por qué la salud mental importa y formas cotidianas de cuidarla, desde la gratitud, el sueño y el ejercicio hasta la conexión con otros, la meditación y la relajación.
- [Balance y armonía: confrontación del COVID-19 después de la vacuna](https://hscfdoral.com/2021/04/balance-y-armonia-confrontacion-del-covid-19-despues-de-la-vacuna/): Una mirada a cómo el COVID-19 afectó la salud emocional, qué reportaron los primeros estudios sobre miedo, ansiedad y depresión, y qué apoyos fortalecen la resiliencia.
